Recovery rule: post-event pressure above pre-event pressure is overshoot; if event pressure is lower than pre-event pressure and post-event pressure rises above event pressure without exceeding pre-event pressure, classify as pressure recovers; if post-event pressure does not rise above event pressure and remains below pre-event pressure, classify as persistent pressure stress.
